value.summary: The change updates the default model configuration to use GLM 5.2 for both scan and deep tiers, adds a reasoning_effort config field and wires it through the OpenRouter gateway, and adds test coverage for the new reasoning_options function and model pricing. All behavioural changes are tested: the new reasoning_options function has unit tests, the config-to-gateway wire is tested, the default model set is checked for price entries, and the new pricing logic is pinned against real measured figures. No test gaps were found.
